desktop.notes: • Review sidebar, to the finish line: ALBUMS moved up - between the numbers and Continue review, set apart by lines - and it folds (▾). The set list under "Choose best from sets" folds with its own chevron, and so does More review tools. Every task and tool has a thin progress line that fills up (green when finished); finished ones are crossed out with a ✓. Hide done (next to "3 of 9 done") leaves only what is still to do. Folds and Hide done are remembered; everything starts folded (open what you need).
